name: One-Hand Form Shooting
setup: Square to the basket a step or two away, ball on the finger pads of the shooting hand.
cues: Shooting hand only on the ball, a step from the basket, the follow-through held.
Elbow under the ball, the ball over the shooting-side shoe.
Push the floor away and let the ball leave on the way up.

faults.fix: Rest the ball on the finger pads, a gap of air under the palm.
Shoot up toward the ceiling first, then down into the basket.
The guide hand only holds the side of the ball; it comes off first.

name: Free Throw Routine
setup: Start at the first spot of the drill, square to the basket, ball ready on the finger pads.
cues: The same breath, the same dribbles, the same release every time.
Same routine every shot: feet, ball up, push the floor away, follow through.
Hold the follow-through until the ball lands.

faults.fix: Set the feet square on the floor before every shot.
Push the floor away harder: the power comes from the ground.
